# elemento_loadbalancer (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento loadbalancer resource on the cloud selected by `target`. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) ARN of the load balancer.
- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `dns_name` (String) DNS name of the load balancer.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer is internet-facing.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `name` (String) Name of the load balancer.
- `port` (Number) Listener port.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
- `scheme` (String) Listener scheme.
- `security_group_id` (String) ID of the security group.
- `state` (String) Current state reported by the service.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `target_group_arn` (String) ARN of the target group.
- `type` (String) Load balancer type.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC the resource belongs to.
